service.label: home-hub-agent
service.text:
# home-hub-agent: the Home Hub push agent (docs/agent.md section 5), written by scripts/install-host-agent.mjs --core.
# Do not edit: run the installer again. It runs as the system account home-hub-agent, never as root; its privileged
# reads go through the fixed lines of /etc/sudoers.d/home-hub-agent.
[Unit]
Description=Home Hub push agent
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=home-hub-agent
Group=home-hub-agent
ExecStart="/usr/bin/node" "/opt/home-hub-agent/scripts/agent/agent.mjs" "--config" "/etc/home-hub-agent" "--state" "/var/lib/home-hub-agent"
WorkingDirectory=/opt/home-hub-agent
Environment="HOME=/var/lib/home-hub-agent"
LoadCredential=agent-key:/etc/home-hub-agent/agent.key
StateDirectory=home-hub-agent
StateDirectoryMode=0700
Restart=always
RestartSec=30
# 78: agent.json or specs.txt failed its check at start; the agent stays stopped until the installer runs again.
RestartPreventExitStatus=78
# Only sandboxing that leaves sudo working: for a unit with User= (no CAP_SYS_ADMIN), PrivateDevices=,
# ProtectKernelTunables=, ProtectKernelModules=, LockPersonality=, RestrictRealtime=, RestrictAddressFamilies= and the
# other seccomp-based settings imply NoNewPrivileges=yes, and the setuid sudo could then never become root.
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/home-hub-agent
ProtectControlGroups=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
